facts.summary: A beneficiary can check the status of a submitted PDS complaint through the applicable official grievance or complaint-status system of the concerned State or Union Territory, where such a facility is available.
facts.authority: The concerned State or Union Territory Food and Civil Supplies authority is responsible for the applicable PDS grievance-management process.
status_tracking: Use the official complaint-status facility provided by the concerned State or Union Territory.
Enter the complaint or reference number requested by the applicable system.
Follow any additional verification or information requested by the official system.
facts.reference_number: A complaint reference or acknowledgement number may be generated when a complaint is submitted. The beneficiary should retain it for future status tracking.
possible_statuses: Other status labels defined by the applicable State/UT grievance system
facts.status_meaning: The exact meaning and labels of complaint statuses can vary according to the grievance system used by the concerned State or Union Territory.
facts.online_availability: Online complaint-status tracking depends on the grievance-management system provided by the concerned State or Union Territory.
facts.if_status_not_available: If an online status facility is unavailable or the complaint cannot be located, the beneficiary should contact the concerned State/UT Food and Civil Supplies authority through its official assistance or grievance channel.
facts.state_specific: The complaint-status portal, required information, status labels and tracking procedure can differ between States and Union Territories.
important_notes: Keep the complaint reference or acknowledgement number after filing a complaint.
Use only the official State/UT grievance or complaint-status system.
Do not assume that every State/UT uses the same complaint-status categories.
A complaint showing as submitted does not necessarily mean that it has been resolved.
Do not provide an exact status or resolution unless it is obtained from the applicable official system.

faqs.question: How can I check my ration complaint status?
faqs.answer: Use the official complaint-status facility of your State or Union Territory and provide the complaint or reference number requested by the system.

faqs.question: Where can I check my PDS complaint status?
faqs.answer: Check the official PDS or Food and Civil Supplies grievance system of the concerned State or Union Territory.

faqs.question: What number do I need to track my complaint?
faqs.answer: Use the complaint or acknowledgement/reference number provided when the complaint was submitted, if one was generated.

faqs.question: I lost my complaint reference number. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Contact the concerned State/UT Food and Civil Supplies authority through its official assistance or grievance channel to determine the available recovery procedure.

faqs.question: My complaint says it is under process. What does that mean?
faqs.answer: It generally indicates that the complaint is still being reviewed or processed. The exact status meaning depends on the applicable State/UT grievance system.

faqs.question: How do I know if my ration complaint is resolved?
faqs.answer: Check the complaint status through the applicable official State/UT grievance system. The system should display the current status when tracking is available.
